name: Multiplayer Cursors
summary: A shared canvas where a teal 'Acme Pulse' cursor inspects every chart frame and the on-call human flies over to make the call.
look: Dotted off-white design-tool canvas with white chart frames, named cursors with label pills, selection handles and an avatar stack. The proof beat switches to follow mode: a thick teal border and a 'Following Acme Pulse' tab.

components.name: Avatar stack
components.role: who is present; Pulse joining is the reveal

motion.name: Interpolated cursor glide
motion.how: bezier paths with slight overshoot, 0.6-0.9 s sine.inOut, arrival on the beat

motion.name: Selection snap
motion.how: scale 1.06 to 1 in 0.18 s on the snare

motion.name: Follow-cam
motion.how: camera eases to the agent's viewport with a 0.2 s lag, border draws on in one beat

story: Hook: a board of 38 dashboard frames, one lone cursor drifting away from the checkout frame. Reveal: a teal cursor streaks in dragging the Acme Pulse text layer and joins the avatar stack. Proof: follow mode on Pulse, which boxes the checkout conversion drop, pins 'Checkout conversion −18% · since 09:42 · after deploy #2231', and Sam's cursor clicks Roll back. CTA: lockup, 'You ship. Pulse watches.', both cursors parked by a selected Start free button.
adapt: Replace the chart frames with your own screens or objects and name the agent cursor after your feature; the comment thread carries your single most important alert.

fit.risk: more than 2-3 cursors reads as chaos; zoom so one frame fills half the square
